entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket receiving raw media assets and triggering processing workflows.

entities.name: STEP FUNCTIONS
entities.rationale: AWS Step Functions orchestrating the pipeline with a direct visible arrow pointing to DynamoDB.

entities.name: ELEMENTAL MEDIACONVERT
entities.rationale: AWS Elemental MediaConvert performing video transcoding; no visual arrow connecting it to DynamoDB.

entities.name: REKOGNITION
entities.rationale: Amazon Rekognition extracting visual entities and features from video.

entities.name: TRANSCRIBE
entities.rationale: Amazon Transcribe converting audio streams into speech-to-text transcriptions.

entities.name: COMPREHEND
entities.rationale: Amazon Comprehend performing natural language processing on text transcripts.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: Amazon DynamoDB storing metadata, receiving arrows from Step Functions, Rekognition, Transcribe, and Comprehend.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Amazon EC2 component inside the Reach Engine box receiving arrow from DynamoDB.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Amazon EKS cluster component inside the Reach Engine box alongside EC2, without direct internal arrows between EC2 and EKS.

visual_connections.description: S3 event triggers the execution of the Step Functions orchestration workflow.
Step Functions invokes MediaConvert to initiate video transcoding jobs.
Step Functions triggers Amazon Rekognition for computer vision processing.
Step Functions triggers Amazon Transcribe for speech-to-text conversion.
Step Functions connects directly to DynamoDB via a visible arrow.
Rekognition outputs object detection and computer vision metadata to DynamoDB.
Transcribe writes text transcription results directly to DynamoDB.
Transcribed text is passed to Amazon Comprehend for natural language processing.
Comprehend stores extracted NLP entities and sentiment analysis in DynamoDB.
DynamoDB arrow points to the Reach Engine box (containing EC2 and EKS).
